04 · component surface gallery

Six practical background/border/styling techniques with exact rendered examples.

restored section
Gradient border

Inner layer clips to padding-box. Rim layer clips to border-box behind a transparent border.

Glass panel

Translucent fill, border, backdrop blur, and inset highlights combine to create glass.

Content spotlight

Glow is restricted to the content-box while lower layers fill padding and border.

Mask rim

A pseudo-element can create a border ring without consuming real border space.

Inset text

Engraved text uses background color plus opposing light/dark shadows.

Dot-rim texture

Small radial dots repeat in the border layer while the panel fill remains clean.

09 · decision table

Which property solves which visual problem?

Goal
Use
Watch for
Move a highlight/texture inside a card
background-origin + background-position
Origin changes the coordinate system. Clip does not.
Prevent a layer from bleeding into padding/border
background-clip: content-box or padding-box
Clip trims the visible area after the layer has been positioned.
Gradient text
background-clip: text + transparent fill
Opaque text fill covers the gradient.
Gradient border
fill padding-box, rim border-box
Border must usually be transparent.
06 · requested multi-layer card breakdown

Final construction card now includes complete copyable CSS.

background stack + clipping + shadow
box-area diagram
Box areas define visual responsibilities.

Content-box is the main material, padding-box is the bevel/mid-surface, and border-box is the rim.

background stack
1cyan radial / content
2blue radial / content
3base linear / content
4conic bevel / padding
5rim linear / border
The first background layer is visually on top.

Highlights come first, base material sits behind them, and the border rim sits at the back.

clipping map
content-box
highlight + fill
padding-box
bevel
border-box
rim
Each layer is clipped to the box it is responsible for.

This avoids one giant gradient doing every job and makes the card easier to tune.

shadow diagram
Shadows finish the dimensional effect.

Outer shadows lift, ambient glow adds atmosphere, and inset shadows define internal edges.

final construction
Finished component = clipped paint + lighting.

The exact CSS below can be copied directly onto a card-like element.

Complete final construction CSS 
border: 1px solid transparent;
border-radius: 34px;
padding: 25px;
background-repeat: no-repeat;
background-blend-mode: normal;
background:
  radial-gradient(ellipse at 18% 12%, rgb(42 255 202 / 16%) 0%, rgb(42 255 202 / 7%) 20%, transparent 48%) content-box,
  radial-gradient(ellipse at 88% 78%, rgb(36 117 255 / 13%) 0%, rgb(36 117 255 / 6%) 24%, transparent 58%) content-box,
  linear-gradient(150deg, rgb(14 25 29 / 100%) 0%, rgb(7 12 17 / 100%) 48%, rgb(3 5 8 / 100%) 100%) content-box,
  conic-gradient(from 240deg at 50% 50%, rgb(2 5 7 / 100%) 0deg, rgb(10 35 39 / 100%) 52deg, rgb(37 196 169 / 44%) 92deg, rgb(9 15 21 / 100%) 152deg, rgb(3 5 8 / 100%) 222deg, rgb(29 87 134 / 46%) 292deg, rgb(2 5 7 / 100%) 360deg) padding-box,
  linear-gradient(145deg, rgb(78 255 220 / 58%) 0%, rgb(19 53 61 / 100%) 18%, rgb(3 6 9 / 100%) 43%, rgb(45 111 170 / 55%) 70%, rgb(4 7 11 / 100%) 100%) border-box;
box-shadow:
  0 20.2px 43.2px rgb(0 0 0 / 68%),
  0 9.4px 20.2px rgb(0 16 22 / 60%),
  0 0 24.5px rgb(34 255 213 / 7%),
  inset 0 1px 0 rgb(196 255 246 / 8%);
01 · origin clarified

Origin is about where a layer is measured from, not where it is cut off.

same panel · same layer · different origin

These are full panel examples. The bright dot/glow is the same background layer in every card. Only `background-origin` changes, so the layer's coordinate system moves from the outer border edge, to the padding edge, to the content edge.

Position starts at the outside border edge.
Position starts after the border.
Position starts after border + padding.
Plain-English difference: `origin` moves the coordinate grid used by the background layer. `clip` decides how much of the already-positioned layer is visible. That is why the generator below lets you change both separately on a real panel.
